thread:
kate: Rolling out v2024.11 to canary (10%) in us-west and eu-north. Quick heads-up: QA saw intermittent tokenizer mismatches on long system prompts. Can ops do a stop/go vote?

deploy-bot: deploy 1861230987 initiated by kate  canary -> 10%. Targets healthy 7/70. Logs: `tokenizer/service` available.

jon: Which image tag? We shipped token-fix-3 in this build; fallback was intended to be on but config indicates fallback=false in the artifact.

tara: That's right, packaging step overwrote runtime defaults. I think switching the runtime flag is safe.

ops-runner: Proposal: hold at 10% for now. Remote config flip to `runtime.tokenizer.fallback=true` for rollout=canary, observe 15m. If error rate drops <0.2% we continue ramp; if not, roll to 0% and pin to v2024.10.

kate: Good plan. Who toggles?

deploy-bot: running: `rwctl prod config set runtime.tokenizer.fallback true --selector rollout=canary`
deploy-bot: matched 7 targets, applying...

deploy-bot: config applied to 7/7 targets. status=ok.

ops-runner: Watching dashboards. Initial 7m: parse-error-rate in eu-north down from 0.8% -> 0.12%. p95 latency improved ~30ms. Recommend baking 15m then decide.

jon: I ran a local replay of 120 long prompts against canary and saw 1 parse error. Looks stable with fallback.

release-manager: Change window until 17:30 UTC. Quick thumbs vote: :thumbsup: to proceed to 25% after bake, :thumbsdown: to keep at 10%/rollback. Please vote.

kate: :thumbsup: (after 15m bake)

jon: :thumbsup:

tara: :thumbsup:

ops-runner: :thumbsup: (monitoring alerts)

release-manager: Consensus -> ramp post-bake. I'll annotate ticket with cfg note and release-note update. Assign follow-up to tara for packaging fix so fallback default isn't overwritten next time.

deploy-bot: annotate rollout 1861230987: "fallback=true applied via rwctl; bake hold until 1861231887"

kate: Thanks. Tara, once the packaging fix lands, we should unpin manual fallback change.

tara: Will open a PR to default fallback=true and include a unit test for config template. PR: `fix/tokenizer-defaults`

ops-runner: scheduled ramp to 25% at 1861231887 (15m). Keeping alarm runbook ready.

kate: Standby on monitoring. If any new parse spikes, we revert and file a postmortem.

deploy-bot: scheduled action: ramp to 25% at 1861231887 unless hold flag set.
